COGNITIVE TERRAIN · IMMERSIVE EDITION VOICE PACK
================================================

This is an optional add-on. The game is complete without it.

With it, a narrator reads the week in review aloud at the end of each week,
told by whichever side is ahead on Decision Health. The voice is synthetic:
it is generated on your own computer by an open-source text-to-speech model.
Nothing is sent over the internet.

HOW TO INSTALL
  Web or browser version: open the game, then Settings (gear) > Narration >
  "Load voice pack..." and choose this zip file. You only do this once per
  browser.
  Windows, macOS and Linux downloads: put this zip file next to the game
  program and start the game; it is picked up automatically. You can also
  load it from Settings as above.

  Leave the file zipped. If you have unzipped it already, choose all of the
  unzipped files together in the same window.

HOW TO REMOVE
  Settings > Narration > "Remove voice pack".

WHAT IS INSIDE
  Model: Kokoro-82M by hexgrad, ONNX export by onnx-community,
  {{MODEL}}. Licence: Apache 2.0.
  Speech engine, built from these open-source packages:
{{PACKAGES}}
  Full licence texts are in the LICENSES folder. manifest.json lists every
  file with its SHA-256 fingerprint; the game checks them before it uses
  the pack.

Cognitive Terrain itself is not open source: see the game's own licence.
